_how: Update on every release: add Kev's time for the sitting (measured from his message times in the chat, plus 10 minutes per sitting), refresh 'people' from the sheet, then run python3 tools/build_stats.py. Releases, versions and dates come from git and gate.js. Tag each sitting with its release so the page can show hours per release.
